name: Siena AI
tagline: Autonomous AI customer experience platform for e-commerce brands.
description: Siena AI is an autonomous customer experience platform built for e-commerce and retail brands, deploying AI agents that resolve support, shopping, and post-purchase questions across email, chat, and social DMs. It handles tasks like order tracking, returns, address changes, and subscription management in over 100 languages, and is designed to blend automation with brand-aligned, empathetic tone. It integrates with existing helpdesk and commerce stacks rather than replacing them.
insight: Raised a $4.7M seed in 2023; its two founders are repeat conversational-commerce entrepreneurs who launched Siena in 2022.
edge: Built specifically for commerce CX — handles order tracking, returns, subscriptions, and social DMs across 100+ languages, not just chat deflection.
pros: Works across email, chat, and social DMs
cons: Aimed at brands, not SMB self-serve
